footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the Reporting Person in connection with the Company's annual equity compensation program for non-employee direc-tors, consistent with prior annual director grants and pursuant to the Company's approved equity incentive plan. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Company's common stock upon vesting. The RSUs are scheduled to vest on July 29, 2027, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service through the ap-plicable vesting date.
